items.what: In v2.1.325 (Nov 13, 2026), sandboxed Bash commands follow the normal permission flow by default instead of running without prompts, and scheduled tasks and /loop ask before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks.
items.test: If you rely on sandboxed commands or scheduled tasks running unattended, run one after upgrading and watch for new prompts. To keep the old sandbox behavior, set sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true; to let a scheduled task run a skill, add Skill(name) to permissions.allow.

items.what: GitHub said on Nov 13, 2026 that Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 leave all Copilot experiences on Dec 14, 2026 (Haiku 4.5 stays for individual annual-plan subscribers).
items.source_name: GitHub changelog: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December (Nov 13, 2026)
items.test: Search Copilot settings, custom agents, CLI scripts and SDK code for those model names and switch before Dec 14 to the suggested replacements: Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon or Grok 4.7. Admins who turned off default model enablement must enable the replacements.

deadlines.label: six Copilot models deprecated (Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6, Kimi K3)

items.what: In 1.0.112 (Nov 13, 2026), the CLI uses each model's recommended context window by default, keeping any context size you chose explicitly. copilot -p "/compact" --silent no longer prints the compaction result line to stdout.
items.test: If you budget AI credits per session, check /context after upgrading to see the new window size. If a script parses the output of copilot -p "/compact" --silent, run it and confirm it no longer expects the compaction line.
